mapper.select: SELECT id FROM currencies WHERE currency_code = #{currencyCode}

SELECT er.rate_date AS rateDate, er.deal_base_rate AS dealBaseRate FROM exchange_rates er JOIN currencies c ON er.target_currency_id = c.id WHERE c.currency_code = #{currencyCode} ORDER BY er.rate_date DESC LIMIT #{days}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exchange_rates (base_currency_id, target_currency_id, currency_unit, deal_base_rate, prev_rate, rate_date, fetched_at) VALUES (#{baseCurrencyId}, #{targetCurrencyId}, #{currencyUnit}, #{dealBaseRate}, #{prevRate}, #{rateDate}, #{fetchedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE deal_base_rate = VALUES(deal_base_rate), prev_rate = VALUES(prev_rate), fetched_at = VALUES(fetched_at)
